DO NOT WRITE IN ANY BARCODES. There are thirty questions on this paper. Answer all questions. For each question there are four possible answers A, B, C and D. Choose the one you consider correct and record your choice in soft pencil on the separate Answer Sheet. Read the instructions on the Answer Sheet very carefully. Each correct answer will score one mark. A mark will not be deducted for a wrong answer. Any rough working should be done in this booklet.
A government proposes to introduce a road congestion charge which would require private motorists to pay a toll for road use. Which statement relating to the proposal is normative?

options.A: Bus passengers will benefit at the expense of motorists.
options.B: Motorists with higher incomes will be prepared to pay the charge in return for reduced journey times.
options.C: Motorists with lower incomes will not be able to afford to use the roads.
options.D: The proposal will be unfair to motorists who have no alternative means of transport.

questions.questionText: A firm changes the type of product it produces. What might limit the firm’s ability to use division of labour?

options.A: The new production method is more capital intensive.
options.B: The new production method is very expensive.
options.C: The new product is made to specific customer requirements.
options.D: The new product requires specialised labour.

questions.questionText: A group of tourists become stranded on a desert island. They decide to use their own system of money. Which statement about their choice of money is correct?

options.A: Coins in their possession would be suitable if there are enough of them.
options.B: Fruit fallen from trees would be suitable because it has intrinsic value as a food.
options.C: Pebbles from the seashore would be suitable because they are both durable and plentiful.
options.D: Seaweed would be suitable as it is in unlimited supply around the coast.

questions.questionText: What is likely to affect the position of the demand curve for tickets to pop concerts but not the position of the supply curve?

options.A: a change in incomes of potential customers
options.B: a change in price of tickets to the concerts
options.C: a change in rents charged by venue owners
options.D: a change in seating capacity of concert venues

questions.questionText: In which set of circumstances will prices play no part in determining how resources are allocated between alternative uses but may still have a role as a rationing mechanism?

options.B: The government sets minimum wages for all workers below the market rates of pay.
options.C: The quantities of consumer goods produced are determined by the government.
options.D: The total income consumers have available to spend is fixed by the government.

options.B: Demand is perfectly inelastic.
options.C: Supply is perfectly elastic.
options.D: Supply is perfectly inelastic.

options.D: an appreciation of the Saudi Arabian currency
